title: wallet-service
blurb: A payments wallet is letting users overdraft and waiving fees on small transfers. Read the spec in the tests, fix the service.
brief:
This wallet module powers peer-to-peer transfers. Finance has flagged two incidents:

1. Some accounts have **negative balances** after transfers.
2. Small transfers are going through with **zero fees** — the fee schedule says every transfer costs at least 1 cent.

The failing tests encode the correct business rules. Read them like a spec, then fix `wallet_service/service.py`.

**Your job:** all tests green. Don't change what passing tests already verify.
